title: EZH2 Mutation and Epigenetic Heterogeneity in B-Cell Lymphoma
content: In collaboration with the Shema Lab at the Weizmann Institute, we published new findings on how the EZH2-Y646N mutation reshapes chromatin states in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, using CyTOF-based histone profiling.

title: PyPAS: New Open-Source Tool for Positron Annihilation Spectroscopy
content: We released PyPAS, a Python package for Doppler Broadening analysis in positron annihilation spectroscopy, including coincidence filtering, 2D analysis, and positron diffusion modeling.
